boundTo.check: readAt.revision is an ancestor of the v0.1.0-beta.14 tag (0c62fd38), and each product decision record cited in sources has the same git blob at both commits (checked 2026-10-07), so the statements read at readAt are unchanged at this release.

description: Deterministic secret detection and redaction for runtime data; the Node package is measured through its public API with its default detectors.

outOfScope.text: Credentials cut by a line break, string-literal operator, continuation, markdown line ending or escaped newline: not reconstructed.
Base64, hex, percent-encoded and other encoded carriers: not decoded; a raw encoded value claims nothing.
No declared netrc, kubeconfig user token, HTTP session cookie, Azure SAS, S3-presigned or GCS-signed-URL family.
Values in those carriers are claimed only when a supported detector reads them independently, and that claim is incidental.
The personal-data profile, selectors and the pii:us add-on: off in the published runs; default credential detectors only.
The CLI, WebAssembly and Python surfaces: not run; the Node package's public API only.
JSON {"name": ..., "value": ...} object pairs (HAR postData params and queryString members): not read as a name with its value.
A credential name that keys an object holding a "value" member (Terraform state outputs): not read; the one-line assignment form is.
A token behind a percent-encoded delimiter (%22, %3D, %2F): not read for any family; percent-encoding is not decoded.
HTTP session cookies in HAR headers and cookies arrays: no session-cookie family, and no name/value pair reading.

sources: benchmarks/official-runs.json: the run configuration credential-public-v1 (mode "Published npm package · default detectors", runtime node)

ownerConfirmations.statement: The 13 provisional product-scope statements of the #698 triage (netrc, kubeconfig user token and client key, HTTP session cookie, Azure SAS, S3-presigned and GCS-signed-URL carriers) are confirmed as the owner's product-scope decision, based on the product's own documentation at the revision above. They are the owner's decision on the product's docs, not a statement of the core maintainers beyond redact-secret#1203 and PR #1204.

The 4 scope statements of core redact-secret#1205 / PR #1206 (JSON name/value object pairs, a credential name that keys an object holding a value member, a token behind a percent-encoded delimiter, HTTP session cookies in HAR headers and cookies arrays) are registered as the owner's product-scope decision, based on the product's own decision record at the revision above (decision-settle-the-snapshot-2026-10-04-4-added-case-roots). The earlier statements were re-read unchanged at this revision. They are the owner's decision on the product's docs; the claim 'not read' is a scope fact the core records, never a measured result.
